description:

title: R&D Engineer – Drone & UAV Technologies (M.Tech – ECE)
description:
**# Hiring: R&D Engineer – Drone & UAV Technologies (M.Tech – ECE)**

**\*Company:\* Interland Technology Services Pvt. Ltd.**

**\*Location:\* Kochi, Kerala, India**

**\*Job Type:\* Full-Time | R&D / Product Engineering**

**\*Experience:\* Fresh Graduates / Final-Year M.Tech Students**

**\*Industry:\* Drone Technology | UAV | Aerospace Electronics | Embedded Systems**

**## About the Opportunity**

Interland Technology Services Pvt. Ltd. is establishing an exciting new technology venture in Kochi, focused on the \*research, design, and development of next-generation Drone, FPV (First Person View) UAV, and advanced unmanned aerial systems.\*

We are looking for passionate, innovative, and technically strong \*M.Tech graduates and final-year postgraduate students in Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE)\* who are eager to apply their academic knowledge to real-world engineering challenges.

This is an opportunity to join an emerging R&D team at an early stage and contribute to the development of innovative UAV technologies, from concept and prototyping to testing and product development.

**## Educational Qualifications**

\*M.Tech / M.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE)\* or a closely related specialization, with a concentration in one or more of the following areas:

1. \*Signal Processing & Digital Electronics\*

2. \*Communication Engineering / Communication Systems\*

3. \*Optoelectronics & Optical Communication\*

4. \*Microwave & Radar Engineering\*

**\*Who Can Apply:\***

- Recent M.Tech graduates (freshers are welcome).

- Final-year M.Tech students currently working on their dissertation or research projects.

- Candidates with strong academic projects, research experience, or demonstrated interest in UAV, RF, communication, or embedded electronics.

**## Key Responsibilities**

- Participate in the research, design, prototyping, and testing of drone and FPV UAV electronic systems.

- Research and develop wireless communication, telemetry, video transmission, and signal-processing solutions for UAV applications.

- Work on RF systems, antennas, communication links, and related electronic subsystems.

- Explore applications of radar, optical sensors, imaging, and sensor technologies in unmanned aerial platforms.

- Support the design, integration, and validation of embedded electronic hardware and communication modules.

- Conduct laboratory experiments, simulations, performance evaluations, and technical feasibility studies.

- Collaborate with the engineering team on proof-of-concept development, prototype integration, and product innovation.

- Prepare technical documentation, research findings, and engineering test reports.

**## Desired Technical Skills**

Candidates with knowledge or practical exposure in any of the following areas will have an advantage:

- Digital Signal Processing (DSP), FPGA, and digital electronics.

- RF communication, wireless systems, antenna design, and microwave engineering.

- Digital and analog communication systems, modulation, and signal analysis.

- Embedded systems, microcontrollers, and electronic circuit design.

- MATLAB, Simulink, Python, C/C++, or relevant engineering simulation tools.

- Software Defined Radio (SDR), telemetry, and wireless video transmission.

- Optical sensors, image processing, radar, and sensor integration.

- UAV systems, FPV drones, flight controllers, or robotics.

\*Prior drone industry experience is NOT mandatory.\* Strong engineering fundamentals, practical problem-solving abilities, and a willingness to learn are more important.

**## What We Offer**

- Opportunity to be part of a new and ambitious UAV technology startup from its early stages.

- Hands-on exposure to cutting-edge drone, FPV, and advanced electronics technologies.

- Opportunity to transform academic research and M.Tech dissertation work into practical engineering solutions.

- Direct involvement in R&D, prototyping, testing, and product development.

- A collaborative, innovation-driven environment with opportunities for professional growth.

**## Ideal Candidate**

We are particularly interested in candidates who enjoy \*building, experimenting, researching, and solving complex engineering problems\*, rather than focusing exclusively on theoretical work.

If you are passionate about electronics, communication technologies, and unmanned aerial systems, we would love to hear from you.

**## How to Apply**

Interested candidates are invited to apply through LinkedIn with:

- Updated CV / Resume

- M.Tech specialization and academic background

- Brief description of dissertation, research, or relevant technical projects

\*Join us in Kochi and help shape the future of unmanned aerial technology!\*

\*Interland Technology Services Pvt. Ltd.\*

  **compliance matrices**

  **Pink Team, Red Team, and Gold Team**

* Collaborate with leadership and business development teams to strengthen federal market positioning.
* Research federal agencies, buying patterns, competitors, incumbents, and upcoming procurements.
* Assist with development of
  **capability statements, one-pagers, presentations, white papers, and sources-sought responses**
  .
* Support teaming and subcontractor research when required.

Required Qualifications

* **3+ years of experience**
  in federal proposal writing, capture management, business development, or federal contracting.
* Demonstrated experience with
  **U.S. federal government proposals and solicitations**
  .
* Hands-on experience with
  **GSA MAS / GSA eBuy**
  is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of federal solicitation terminology, including
  **RFI, Sources Sought, RFQ, RFP, SOW, PWS, SOO, L/M sections, evaluation criteria, and compliance matrices**
  .
* Experience researching opportunities through
  **SAM.gov**
  and other federal procurement resources.
* Strong proposal writing, editing, proofreading, and document-management skills.
* Experience working with technical SMEs and translating technical information into proposal-ready content.
* Ability to manage multiple proposals and competing deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to identify compliance gaps.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience supporting
  **GSA MAS SINs and eBuy opportunities**
  .
* Experience with
  **IDIQ, GWAC, BPA, BOA, and task-order competitions**
  .
* Knowledge of federal acquisition processes and
  **FAR/DFARS**
  requirements.
* Experience with federal staffing, IT services, professional services, or technology contracts.
* Experience supporting
  **8(a), SDVOSB, WOSB, HUBZone, or other small-business federal contracting programs**
  .
* Proposal certification such as
  **APMP**
  is a plus.
* Experience with proposal management tools, CRM systems, or platforms such as
  **GovWin, Deltek, Salesforce, Loopio, Responsive, or similar systems**
  .

Core Competencies

* Federal Proposal Writing
* Capture Management
* GSA MAS
* GSA eBuy
* Federal Business Development
* SME Coordination
* Proposal Reviews
* FAR/DFARS Awareness
* SAM.gov Research
* Task-Order Proposal Development

title: Content Writing Intern
description:
2Base Technologies is at a deliberate stage of building its marketing content function, and this internship is the entry point into that function.
 



 We are a technology services company with over 16 years of delivery experience, working with mid\-market and enterprise clients across the United States and the United Kingdom. Our work spans custom software development, AI implementation, legacy system modernisation, and operational transformation.
 



 This is an entry\-level writing role with a specific, practical purpose. It is not a social media role and it is not a generalist marketing role. If that distinction is unclear from the outset, this is probably not the right fit.
 



  





**What This Role Exists to Do** 




 Technology is complicated. Our job is to make it clear. This role exists to support the production of written content that explains what 2Base does, what problems we solve, and why that matters to the people we work with. The output is blog posts that earn attention, social copies that are actually read, and supporting content that helps the marketing function move.
 



 You will work from structured briefs, receive direct feedback on every draft, and build a practical foundation in technology content writing. The audience is technical leaders and business decision\-makers at mid\-market companies. Writing that is clear, specific, and free of noise. That is the standard you will be working towards and learning to meet.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 



* First drafts of blog posts on technology topics including software development, AI implementation, digital transformation, and IT services written from structured briefs provided by the Marketing Manager
* Social media copies for the 2Base LinkedIn page and other channels, produced to brief and reviewed before publishing
* Research for content briefs – gathering background, understanding the topic, and returning with enough substance to write from
* Supporting long\-form content production: contributing sections, drafts, and revisions under direction
* Proofreading and editing your own drafts against 2Base brand voice guidelines before submitting



  





**What You Will Not Own** 



* Content strategy and editorial planning: the Marketing Manager sets the direction and you execute within it
* Publishing decisions: a separate team member manages scheduling and publishing
* Visual design of content assets: the design function owns this
* SEO keyword selection: the SEO specialist sets this and you write within it
* Campaign strategy or audience definition
* Client\-facing communications of any kind



  





**Requirements** 




**Experience** 




  




* Fresh graduates or candidates with up to 2 years of experience. Internship experience in content writing, copywriting, journalism, or technical writing counts.
* Has written something anything that demonstrates the ability to put ideas into clear, readable sentences. College submissions, personal blogs, LinkedIn posts, college magazine articles, or internship work all qualify.
* Has used AI writing tools and understands both their value and their limits. AI is a tool in this role, not the writer.
* Background in engineering, computer science, or information technology is preferred. Graduates from other streams with demonstrated interest in technology topics are also considered.



  





**Writing Ability** 



* Writes clearly in English. Not without errors that improves with practice – but with a clear structure and a readable point.
* Can read a brief and produce something that addresses it, rather than writing whatever comes to mind
* Accepts feedback and revises drafts without treating the edit as personal criticism
* Does not pad. Does not repeat the same point in different words to fill length.



  





**Mindset** 



* Genuinely curious about technology topics: not faking interest to get the job, but actually reading and thinking about what software, AI, and digital infrastructure do in the real world
* Comfortable not knowing things and asking questions before writing rather than guessing
* Fast enough to produce a first draft within a day of receiving a brief, knowing it will be edited
* Treats writing as a skill to develop, not a talent they either have or do not have



  





**What We Are Not Looking For** 



* Candidates who cannot write a coherent paragraph in English independently
* Candidates whose primary interest is social media management, graphic design, or video content, who see this as the nearest available opening
* Candidates who use AI tools as the primary author with only light editing and no independent writing ability
* Candidates who expect senior\-level scope, autonomy, or compensation from Day 1
* Candidates who apply without reading the role description and do not include a writing sample



  





**An Honest Note on This Role** 




 This role joins a marketing function that is still building. You will not step into a well\-established content operation. You will work within a documented brand voice and a defined content direction, but the volume, pace, and iteration rhythm are things you will grow into alongside the team.
 



  





 If you want to start a career in technology content writing and you are prepared to put in the work to learn how a B2B technology company communicates with senior buyers, this is a structured entry point. If you are looking for a creative writing role or a social media job, it is not.
 



  





 To apply: send your CV and one writing sample. A blog post, a college article, a LinkedIn post, or anything else you have written that shows us how you think. If you do not have a writing sample, write 200 words on any technology topic that interests you and send it with your application. Send to: talents@2basetechnologies.com
 



  





 Benefits
 



 A growth\-driven environment with opportunities to lead, innovate, and upskill continuously.
